name: 4-card Brag
description: 4-Card Brag is a British vying/bluffing game: each player gets four cards. Hand rankings are adapted from 3-Card Brag (prials, running flushes, etc.) for four cards. Betting: ante, then match, raise, or fold. Playing blind allows double stakes. Last player or showdown; highest hand wins pot.

history.origins: Variant of Brag, a traditional British gambling game. 3-Card Brag is more common; 4-card version uses same principles.
timeline: Late 18th century: Brag is documented as a popular British gambling game in sources such as Hoyle, and four-card variants follow the same betting and hand-ranking structure.

setup.dealing: Four cards each, face-down; one card sometimes turned for dealer.

rules.objective: Have the best four-card hand at showdown, or bluff others into folding.
rules.gameplay: Ante; deal 4 cards. Betting round(s): match, raise, or fold. Blind play (without looking) pays double. Showdown: best four-card hand wins. Hand rankings: four of a kind, then prials (three of a kind), running flush, flush, pair, high card—adapted for four cards.

strategy.basic: Bluff and read opponents; play blind for value when confident.
strategy.advanced: Read table: many players in = need stronger hand; blind when pot is large and you have a hand.
tips: Four cards; rankings adapted from 3-Card Brag (prials, running flush, etc.).
